description: Task-wise primal-dual Adam drift control from paper §3 Eq. (3), Appendix B Algorithm 1, and Appendix C (paper.txt:241-270, 1391-1423, 1809-1817); see pinned stable/optim.py:46-52, 129-177, 206-291. Uses the paper's squared deadzone thresholds and prior-step violation average. Call start_task() before task 1 and at each task boundary.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, analysis, build, synth

root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stable-drift-control-")
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    label = int(features[0] + features[1] > 0)
    return {"features": features, "labels": label}

dataset = synth.Spec("stable-drift-control-classification", generator=samples, size=24, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
val = dataset.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="val", like=train)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="tabular-classify", optimizer="stable-drift-control", lr=5e-4, max_epochs=1, batch_size=8, device="cpu")
def task_boundaries(step):
    if step == 0 or step == 2:
        trainer.optimizers["default"].start_task()
trainer.add_hook("before_optimizer_step", task_boundaries)
trainer.fit()
result = trainer.evaluate(val)
report = analysis.analyze(model)
examples.title: Train a classifier with task-wise drift control

name: STABLE drift-control optimizer

parameters.betas: pair of Adam coefficients in [0, 1); defaults to (0.9, 0.999)
parameters.deadzone: relative drift-radius deadzone in [0, 1); defaults to 0.05
parameters.drift_budget_sq: positive squared drift budget or 'auto'; auto calibrates from Task 1 updates and falls back to 0.06 when fewer than 12 updates are recorded
parameters.dual_lr: positive dual controller step size; defaults to 0.03
parameters.eps: non-negative Adam denominator epsilon; defaults to 1e-8
parameters.lambda_init: non-negative dual multiplier at the start of task 2; defaults to 1.0
parameters.lambda_max: positive upper cap for the dual multiplier; defaults to 100
parameters.violation_memory: bool controlling the prior-step mean of positive squared-budget violations; defaults to true
parameters.weight_decay: non-negative decoupled weight decay applied after the Adam update; defaults to 0

usage: Trainer(model, train, optimizer='stable-drift-control', lr=5e-4); call trainer.optimizers['default'].start_task() before training and at every task boundary
